faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AutopilotRank

items.question: Will Google penalize AI-generated content?
items.answer: No. Google's policy targets low-quality content, not AI content specifically. Our Humanizer engine produces content designed to read naturally, and we run quality checks before publishing.

items.question: How does AutopilotRank compare to other tools?
items.answer: AutopilotRank combines full automation, human-quality content via our Humanizer engine, native CMS publishing, and GSC integration in one platform. Many tools focus on just one aspect, requiring you to piece together multiple solutions.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to set this up?
items.answer: No. If you can install a WordPress plugin, you can use AutopilotRank. Our guided onboarding walks you through everything in under 15 minutes.

items.question: What CMS platforms do you support?
items.answer: Native integrations: WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Ghost, Notion. Plus webhooks and API for custom platforms.

items.question: Can I review content before it publishes?
items.answer: Yes. Choose between: (1) Full autopilot - content publishes automatically after QA passes, (2) Review mode - content queued for your approval, (3) Draft mode - content saved as drafts in your CMS.

items.question: What's your refund policy?
items.answer: We offer a money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied, contact our support team within the trial period.
